## README

Repository for my second presentation in STAT401 at Loyola University Chicago. 

Present.Rmd outlines the motivation behind this project, and explains how to install Git depending on your OS. 

The Markdown file ConnectingGH&R gives the code and step-by-step written instructions for setting up Github and R. It also outlines how to set up Git/GitHub for new and existing R projects. 
The corresponding R script only has the code, in order of use. 

Jargon/Git Lexicon:
repo- repository. Literally just folder
commit- "save", back up an iteration/changes
remote- a computer/server with your repository on it
clone- when you get the repository from the remote for the first time
pull- get the new commits from collaborators from the remote (from GitHub, to RStudio)
push- send your new changes/commits to the remote (from RStudio, to GitHub)
